summary: Russia (RU) localization of Business Central 29 adds Russian VAT ledgers and settlement, prepayment differences, general ledger correspondence, tax registers and tax differences, fixed assets, cash and bank payment orders, inventory documents with red storno, and statutory forms. It answers what the Russian layer adds to W1 and which objects carry it.
overview:
The Russian layer is large: 879 objects, about 1,145 fields added to W1 tables and 427 procedures added. Most of it is new objects (268 pages, 151 tables, 140 reports, 73 codeunits) plus replaced W1 objects. Learn documents it on the "Russia local functionality" page and on topic pages for financial reports, payables and receivables, fixed assets, inventory, bank and cash, and human resources.

Finance and VAT are the core. Codeunits such as "VAT Settlement Management", "VAT Ledger Management", "VAT Prepayment-Post", "PrepmtDiffManagement" and "G/L Corresp. Management" implement VAT ledgers, VAT settlement, prepayment differences and G/L correspondence. W1 posting objects ("Gen. Jnl.-Post Line", "Purch.-Post", "Sales-Post", "Exch. Rate Adjmt. Process") gain RU procedures, and VAT Entry, VAT Posting Setup, Gen. Journal Line and the ledger entry tables gain many fields. Tax registers (codeunits 17200 to 17207), tax differences (17300 to 17302) and tax calculation (17303 to 17307) support tax accounting.

Operational areas follow the same pattern. Fixed assets get depreciation bonus, FA acts, locations and employees. Inventory gets item documents and red storno. Bank and cash get bank payment orders, cash orders and bank directories. Report helper codeunits produce many printed forms (Factura-Invoice, TORG-12, M-4, FA-1, INV-17, cash orders). Learn also covers the CO-3 cash order journal and CO-4 cash report, as well as payroll and HR topics.
key_points: VAT: VAT ledgers (sales and purchase), additional sheets, VAT settlement and reinstatement, with new fields on VAT Entry and VAT Posting Setup (transfer VAT account, tax invoice amount type).
Prepayments and prepayment differences for customers and vendors, with dedicated accounts, ledger entry fields and FillPrepmtDiffEntryBuff in the apply codeunits.
General ledger correspondence entries, turnover pages and analysis reports, with automatic G/L correspondence set up in General Ledger Setup.
Tax accounting: tax registers by period, tax difference journal, and financial reports with constants, extensions and expressions on account schedules.
Fixed assets: depreciation bonus, FA release, movement and write-off acts, locations and employees, FA charges, inventory, and disposal cost.
Inventory: item documents, red storno corrections, customs declaration (CD) tracking, INV-17 act, TORG-12/13/16/29, M-4, M-11 and M-15 forms.
Bank and cash: bank directory with BIC, bank payment orders, cash account cards, cash orders, CO-3 journal and CO-4 report.
Corrective documents, agreements, letters of attorney and document signatures extend sales and purchase documents; the W1 permission sets LOCAL and LOCAL READ are changed.

areas.what: Holds most Russian own objects: management codeunits for localisation, VAT ledgers, VAT settlement, prepayment differences, corrective documents and agreements. It also holds report helper codeunits for Russian forms, tax register and tax difference codeunits, and hundreds of pages, tables and reports.
areas.why: Learn pages describe VAT ledgers, tax registers, tax differences and unified forms such as TORG-12, CO-3 and CO-4 as local requirements.

areas.what: Extends posting with RU procedures for VAT, prepayment differences, exchange rate adjustment, reversal and VAT settlement batches. Adds many fields to Gen. Journal Line, VAT Entry, VAT Posting Setup, Currency, General Ledger Setup and account schedule tables.
areas.why: Learn pages explain exchange rate adjustment, VAT posting on sales, VAT settlement worksheet and G/L correspondence.

areas.what: Adds Russian fixed asset fields (inventory number, status, depreciation bonus, locations, employees) and RU procedures for depreciation bonus, tax depreciation books, reclassification and disposal. Extends FA setup, posting groups and journals.
areas.why: Learn pages cover depreciation bonus, FA acts, locations and employees, inventory, charges and assessed tax.

areas.what: Adds employee purchases (advance statements), corrective documents, vendor VAT invoice and receipt data, agreements and prepayment fields to purchase documents and vendor ledger entries. Vendor gains Russian codes and VAT agent fields, and Purch.-Post gets RU procedures.
areas.why: Learn pages describe registering VAT on purchase orders, letters of attorney and prepayments.

areas.what: Adds corrective document fields (before and after quantities and amounts), agreements, prepayment fields and Russian codes (KPP, OKPO) to sales documents, customers and ledger entries. Sales-Post gets procedures for corrective documents and prepayment unapply.
areas.why: Learn pages describe prepayments, bill of lading and customer agreements.

areas.what: Adds item document setup, red storno posting, fixed asset links on item and value entries, prepayment difference accounts and form template codes. Extends Item Jnl.-Post Line and Inventory Posting To G/L with RU procedures.
areas.why: Learn pages describe inventory setup, red storno corrections and item documents with forms such as TORG-13 and INV-17.

areas.what: Adds Russian company data (director, OKPO, OGRN, SONO), extra source codes, print and report selection procedures, local country names and the OKEI code on units of measure.

Adds BIC, correspondent accounts, cash order numbering and payment order fields to bank accounts, reconciliation lines, check ledger entries and payment export data. Extends check management and payment export for Russian payment orders.
areas.why: Learn pages describe bank directory, bank payment orders and cash account cards.

areas.what: Changes W1 permission sets (LOCAL, LOCAL READ and fixed asset, vendor and customer sets) to cover the Russian objects.
Extends data exchange definitions and fields with column type and document tags, adds font size to Excel Buffer, and adjusts CSV import and export XMLports.
Adds employee fields (vendor link, bank code, short name, identity document) and name and age procedures. Adds a type to Misc. Article.
areas.why: Learn pages cover payroll, absence, dismissal and staff topics for Russia.

areas.what: Adds data classification for Russian tables and a procedure to move G/L correspondence entries.
Adds a customs declaration number (CD No.) field to warehouse activity lines and bin content buffer.
areas.why: Learn describes CD number tracking for imported goods.

areas.what: Adds a page extension for report selection for production orders.

issues: Overview gives the tax difference codeunits as 17300 to 17307. Only 17300 to 17302 are tax difference objects (TaxDiffJnlManagement, Tax Diff.-Post Jnl. Line, Tax Diff.-Post Jnl. Batch). 17303 to 17307 are tax calculation objects (Tax Calc. Mgt., Tax Calc. Dim. Mgt., Create Tax Calc. Entries and others).

Overview says report helper codeunits produce CO-3 and CO-4. The input has no CO-3 or CO-4 helper, only a Cash Order Report Helper and KO3/KO4 template fields in General Ledger Setup. The other forms listed (Factura-Invoice, TORG-12, M-4, FA-1, INV-17) do have helpers.
Key point 8 says permission sets LOCAL and LOCAL READ are added. The input marks both as changed W1 objects. The 2 permission sets the country adds are not named.
